integrity: Finite exact enumeration agrees with the separate complete analytic argument; external independent validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Only two finite-expectation/covariance laws and their exact signs are established; no full joint distribution or stochastic ordering.
Uniform covariance effects are of order inverse-square sample size.
Implicit older coverage through general weighted permutation enumerators remains a bibliographic risk.
title: Opposite cycle-count covariance signs for linear and circular Ewens successions
